highlights: 【🎬 4K Video & 64MP Clear Imaging】Shoot in 4K at 30fps with a powerful 64MP CMOS sensor, 31 creative filters for vivid, detailed results. This easy-to-use camera is perfect for creating YouTube videos, TikTok clips, travel vlogs, and everyday recording — capturing life's best moments with ease.

【👆 1.7" Touchscreen for Effortless Control】The bright 1.7" HD touch display makes navigation a breeze — simply slide your finger to complete basic tasks like reviewing photos and fine-tuning parameters. Quick-access buttons let you switch between front and rear cameras, zoom in and out, and trigger auto functions with just one tap, giving you flexible control at your fingertips.

【🔄 330° Rotating Lens with 2-Axis Gimbal】The camera features a versatile 330° rotating lens paired with a 2-axis gimbal — perfect for selfies, vlogs, or group photos. Built-in face tracking automatically keeps you centered in the frame, while the 2-axis gimbal ensures smooth, steady shots. The dedicated OK button enables instant auto-focus for sharp, clear shots every time.

【📲 Built-in WiFi for Seamless Phone Connectivity】Easily connect to your phone via built-in WiFi to preview footage in real time and download photos. You can also switch shooting modes — including timelapse and slow-motion — and adjust camera settings directly from your phone, making the entire workflow fro m capture to share smooth and convenient for TikTok or YouTube content.

【🎒 Compact, Portable & Ready for Adventures】Lightweight and pocket-sized, this camera slips right into your bag. Powered by a 2400mAh high-capacity battery, it supports extended recording sessions — ideal for travel, vacations, hiking, and daily use. A built-in tripod lets you set it up anywhere for steady, hands-free shooting with reliable stability.
